SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'CKPC') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, STATUS
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER , A.PO_NO , A.PO_SEQ , A.STATUS , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION , A.UNIT_MEASURE , A.UNIT_PRICE , A.ITEM_QTY , A.ITEM_AMT , A.PLANT , A.RD_DATE , A.PO_CREATE_DATE AS ADD_DATE , A.PURCHASER_ID AS ADD_USER_ID , A.CATEGORY_ID AS ITEM_TYPE , A.REMARK FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, A.STATUS
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATE = SYSDATE, IF_MSG = 'PODT SEND ERROR' WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
